segments.speaker: antinous
segments.caption: Bold-tongued Telemachus, do not lay your blame at our door. It is not the suitors who are at fault but your own mother, that queen of cunning; three years now, and nearly four, she has cheated the hearts of the Achaeans.
segments.delivery: confident accuser converting predation into a grievance against Penelope

segments.speaker: antinous
segments.caption: She set up her great loom in the hall, a shroud, she told us, for the lord Laertes, so no woman of the land could reproach her if he lay in death without a winding-sheet. All day she wove at that web, and every night, with torches set beside her, she unraveled it thread by thread.
segments.delivery: confident accuser converting predation into a grievance against Penelope

segments.caption: A maid betrayed the trick. We caught her at the loom and forced the web to its end.
segments.delivery: frame the action without replacing character agency

segments.speaker: antinous
segments.caption: Send her back to her father Icarius, and let her marry the man he names, and the man she chooses.
segments.delivery: confident accuser converting predation into a grievance against Penelope
